map.分类填写启动期投入与月度运营支出，预估总启动资金: Enter startup one-off investment and monthly operating expenses by category to estimate total initial funding
map.「分类填写启动期投入与月度运营支出，预估总启动资金」按输入参数进行专业计算并输出: Startup one-off investment and monthly operating expenses entered by category estimate the total initial funding by professional calculation from the input parameters.
map.把启动成本拆成一次性投入（注册、场地、设备、首批库存、品牌/开发）与月度运营（工: Split startup costs into one-off investment (registration, venue, equipment, first inventory, branding/development) and monthly operations (salaries, rent, marketing, sundry), accumulating each separately so nothing is missed.
map.按运营月数算运营资金 = 月成本 × 月数，再叠加应急储备（通常 3 个月），得: Operating capital = monthly cost x number of months, then add the emergency reserve (usually 3 months) to get the total recommended initial funding.
map.用总额 ÷ 月成本算资金可支撑月数（跑道），低于 12 个月需补融资或降本。: Divide the total by the monthly cost to get how many months the funding supports (the runway); below 12 months you need more financing or lower costs.
map.一次性：注册 3000 + 场地 20000 + 设备 30000 + 库存 2:
One-off: registration 3,000 + venue 20,000 + equipment 30,000 + inventory 20,000 + branding 15,000 + other 5,000 = 93,000 CNY.
Monthly operations: salaries 30,000 + rent 5,000 + marketing 5,000 + sundry 3,000 = 43,000 CNY.
Operating capital = 43,000 x 12 = 516,000 CNY; emergency reserve = 43,000 x 3 = 129,000 CNY.
Recommended initial funding = 93,000 + 516,000 + 129,000 = 738,000 CNY; the funding supports 738,000 / 43,000 = 17.2 months.
map.应急储备留几个月？: How many months of emergency reserve should be kept?
map.一般留 3 个月运营现金；若融资周期长或收入不确定，留 6 个月更稳妥。储备计入: Keep 3 months of operating cash as a rule; if the fundraising cycle is long or revenue is uncertain, 6 months is safer. The reserve counts toward initial funding, directly lengthening the runway and lowering the risk of running out of cash.
map.跑道低于多少要警惕？: At what runway should I worry?
map.跑道 <12 个月就应启动融资规划，<9 个月加速推进，<6 个月属高危需立即融: Start fundraising planning when the runway is under 12 months, accelerate when it is under 9 months, and treat under 6 months as high risk requiring an immediate raise or spending cuts. Formula: runway = initial funding / monthly cost.
